name: Front Splits
summary: A moving split: front foot on the floor, platform or footbar, back foot against the shoulder rest, the carriage sliding the legs apart and together.
steps: Basic: front foot on the floor beside the footbar, back foot on the shoulder rest, hands on the footbar.
Harder: front foot up on the platform or footbar, back heel against the shoulder rest, both legs long.
Breathe in to let the carriage travel back as you lower into the split.
Breathe out to draw it home with the inner thighs and core.

layers.title: Bend and stretch
layers.text: Bend and straighten the front knee first to prepare.

layers.title: Hands free
layers.text: Arms float out to the sides.

modifications: Keep hands on the footbar, or hold a pole beside the carriage.

cautions.note: Standing balance on a moving carriage.

cues:
Hips face straight ahead.
Front knee in line with the middle toes.
Only go as low as you can come back from.
Lift up out of the hips rather than sinking.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
